query: select table_name, row_security from (select c.relname as table_name, c.relrowsecurity as row_security from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('crowdfunding_advisory_plans','crowdfunding_advisory_engagements','crowdfunding_monthly_reports','crowdfunding_angel_chain_events')) t order by table_name; select code, name, monthly_price_xof, active, sort_order from public.crowdfunding_advisory_plans order by sort_order limit 10;
